name: A hinted mapping whose caller requires the returned address to equal the hint
component: ground-truth pairing for QEMU user mode and shadPS4's direct-memory path
required_postconditions: the address mmap returns equals the address that was hinted

failure_sink.description: the case reports `relocated`: mmap returned SUCCESS at a different address, and a caller requiring identity has no error to check

extraction_limitations: Single-claim contract written to pair with a ground-truth case. It asserts exactly one thing so that a whole-contract verdict can be compared against a single observation without ambiguity.
x_groundtruth: mmap's addr is advisory. The case occupies an address and then hints at it without MAP_FIXED, which is the only case here that produces `relocated` against a real kernel.
